teju: thinking out loud — want to propose a tiny helper that annotates a deploy with a compact release signature + optional pin + change-window so ops and product see intent in one line

maria: curious — can you show what the CLI/command would look like?

teju: sure, sketching a command the deploy-bot could accept:
```
/deploy annotate --sig user-facing-ml-embed-v2 \
               --pin model=embed-v2.1.4 \
               --window '2026-03-22T10:00:00Z/2026-03-22T12:00:00Z' \
               --notes-file ./release_notes/short.md \
               --dry-run
```

maria: nice. would like an auto-generated release note snippet too (one-liner + checklist). can it emit a preview in Slack? :eyes:

deploy-bot: draft-annot-3498124680 created (dry-run). preview: "sig: user-facing-ml-embed-v2 | pin: model=embed-v2.1.4 | window: 2026-03-22T10:00Z-12:00Z"

sam: two asks — 1) a flag to opt-in to automated rollback if canary error rate > threshold, 2) make pinning idempotent so repeated deploys don't clobber pin history

teju: agreed. thinking flags like `--auto-rollback=5% --canary-window=10m` and `--pin-mode=append` vs `--pin-mode=replace`

aleks: release note template idea — short YAML blob embedded so downstream tools pick it up. example:
```yaml
sig: user-facing-ml-embed-v2
short: small encoder tweak to reduce cost at long contexts
checklist:
  - smoke-tests: passed
  - canary: 10k reqs, <5% err
  - rollback-plan: manual / auto-rollback enabled
notes_url: https://git.redwood/release-notes/3498
```

maria: love the YAML. can we have the bot create the PR for the release notes with that template (if `--notes-file` omitted)?

teju: yes — default behavior: if `--notes-file` missing, bot will generate the YAML snippet and attach as a draft PR to the releases repo. we can keep a `--no-pr` override.

release-sheriff-bot: heads-up — canary metrics integration available via `--canary-source=prometheus:ops/canary-embed-v2`

sam: edge-case — what if someone pins a caret range or tag instead of exact version? support `model=embed@^2.1`?

teju: will add simple validation. `--pin` supports exact, semver range, and `latest-compat` alias. will show warning for ranges in `--dry-run`

aleks: one more UX: preview button in the Slack message that expands the YAML and shows `Apply` / `Cancel` actions. then the bot runs a safety preflight (existing preflight hooks) before actually creating the pin/PR.

maria: that reduces noise. can we also add a `--quiet` mode so it doesn't spam release channel when used by quickfixes?

teju: yep — `--notify-level=channel|team|quiet`. default is `team` (ops + product).

maria: ok ship this as an RFC PR? small front-end + bot change + one new webhook from release-sheriff for canary checks. I'll draft the RFC and include the YAML template + minimal flow chart.

teju: I'll open the PR for the bot code and include a mock Slack preview screenshot. assigning to @aleks for release template and @sam for rollback behavior review.

sam: assigning ack, will review later today.

maria: LGTM :+1:

teju: thanks — creating issues and PRs now.
